Subject: PO attached — split invoicing for Q3 renewal + capacity uplift

Hi Camila,

Thanks again for the demo yesterday. We're ready to move forward with the Q3 renewal and the additional 250k tokens/month capacity uplift, but finance needs a couple of things before we can route the PO.

1) We need the invoice split between HyperGrid US (40%) and HyperGrid Ireland Ltd (60%). Please put separate invoice numbers and send two invoices that match the attached PO.
2) Our AP team asked for Redwood's tax details and to confirm whether Redwood can accept Net45 on this renewal.
3) Because HyperGrid Ireland will be the larger payor, AP requires the supplier's EIN and EU VAT documentation (EORI if relevant). I've attached the signed PO (HyperGrid_PO_1287.pdf).

Can you confirm what you'll need from our side (we can provide the Ireland company's VAT number and the remit-to contact)? Also please confirm whether you can split the invoice now or if we should submit two POs.

Thanks — I can get you the Ireland VAT today.

Best,
Elena Kostova
Head of Procurement
HyperGrid

Attachments: HyperGrid_PO_1287.pdf
From: Camila Reyes <camila_reyes@redwood.ai>

Cc: Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 08 Oct 2027 11:04:00 -0400
Subject: Re: PO attached — split invoicing for Q3 renewal + capacity uplift

Hi Elena — thanks for the PO and for the clear breakdown.

We can do split invoicing and issue two separate invoices with distinct invoice numbers that map to the percentages you outlined. A few quick notes and asks so we can move forward this week:

- Required from HyperGrid: Ireland VAT/registration number and the remit-to email for the Ireland entity (we'll send invoice to accounts@hypergrid.finance unless you prefer a different address).
- Redwood needs to confirm supplier tax details: our legal team asks for the purchasing entity's tax form if the payor is non-US. For HyperGrid Ireland that typically means EORI/VAT; for HyperGrid US we'll need a W-9 if the US entity will be the payor on any future invoices.
- Net terms: we can accept Net45 for this renewal on one-off basis pending approval. Jonas, can you confirm accounting's acceptance and how we should reflect terms on each invoice (Net45 for Ireland/Net30 for US?)

Marissa — can you confirm whether we need a copy of HyperGrid's signed W-8BEN-E for our records (we often collect that for non-US corporate payors) or if VAT/EORI is sufficient for the Ireland entity?

I'll prepare a draft invoice pair and SOW line items for the additional capacity (attached: Capacity_Upsell_SOW_Q3.xlsx) and send over as soon as I have the VAT number.

Next steps:
- Elena: send Ireland VAT + remit-to contact (reply OK)
- Jonas: confirm internal approval for Net45 on the Ireland invoice
- Marissa: advise tax document expectations

Thanks — happy to hop on a 15 min call if that's easier.

Best,
Camila Reyes
Account Executive, Renewals 
Redwood Inference

Attachments: Capacity_Upsell_SOW_Q3.xlsx
From: Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.ai>

Date: Mon, 11 Oct 2027 10:22:00 -0400
Subject: Re: PO attached — split invoicing for Q3 renewal + capacity uplift

Hi all — quick internal note and proposed approach:

1) Accounting can accept Net45 on the Ireland invoice as a one-time concession for this renewal; please note we will keep Net30 as standard on the US-side invoices unless otherwise approved by finance.
2) We will issue two invoices tied to the single PO number you provided; our system will append suffixes (e.g., 1287-IRL and 1287-US) so your AP can reconcile easily.
3) For tax docs: Marissa, we'll store the signed W-8BEN-E if HyperGrid provides it, but for EU payors we primarily reference VAT/EORI. Elena — if you upload the VAT number I'll record it in our vendor profile.

Operational ask from Redwood: please confirm the remit-to email for each legal entity (we need both), and confirm the billing contact names so we can put the correct PO reference on each invoice line.

I'll prepare draft invoice PDFs and route them to Camila for review by EOD Tue. Priyom — please allocate the additional 250k token capacity to the Q3 commitment in the billing system once invoices are finalized.

Jonas Weber
Revenue Operations Manager
Redwood Inference
